_comment: FICTIONAL US example agency, the default demo studio (npm run sandbox): an Austin, TX studio like its cast (RFC 2606 .example domains, a 555-01xx phone, an invented address, Central time). Do not edit this file: create your agency in the cockpit (⋯ › Settings writes agency.config.json, which git ignores), or copy this file to agency.config.json and edit the copy. For a US studio: country drives the mail footer (CAN-SPAM: postal address required for a live send), phone formats and TLD guesses; language drives the generated sites, mails and call scripts. No public company registry is wired outside France.
_invoice: invoice.seller: free-text fields printed on invoices. US: taxId (EIN), no SIRET/VAT/RCS/IBAN keys. legal = entity type (LLC, S-Corp…).
